decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Insufficient
details have been provided with regards to the materials/detailing of the
proposed porch. As such, the impacts of the proposal on the character and
appearance of the host property and the integrity of the South Hill
Conservation Area cannot be fully understood nor determined. The proposal would
therefore be contrary to the high-quality design aspiration of the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D1, D3, D4 of The London Plan
(2021), Policy GR1, SP2 and HE1 of the Harrow’s Local Plan (2021-2041), South Hill
Conservation Area Study (2008) and the relevant provisions of the adopted
Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
